name: RentRedi
description: RentRedi is property-management software for landlords and tenants. It combines listings, applications and screening, leases and documents, rent collection, messaging, maintenance, accounting, reporting and partner integrations.
agentUseSummary: RentRedi is visible as a provider-contract security preview. Relay will not collect member credentials or access rental, tenant, screening or payment data until RentRedi publishes or approves a least-privilege production integration contract.

capabilities.label: Review bounded RentRedi integration access
capabilities.description: If RentRedi approves a least-privilege contract, expose only exact-account, exact-property and privacy-redacted tools after legal and security review.

blocked.label: Capture RentRedi member credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not request landlord or tenant passwords, sessions, MFA factors, payment credentials or other account material for this preview.

blocked.label: Read private RentRedi data
blocked.description: Properties, units, listings, applications, tenants, leases, documents, messages, maintenance records, reports and financial data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run financial or screening actions
blocked.description: Rent charges, payment controls, bank connections, applicant screening, credit reporting, leases, tenant invitations, notices and other external actions are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run RentRedi actions before provider approval
blocked.description: No RentRedi tool is callable until RentRedi approves an integration and documents delegated authentication, granular scopes, immutable account and property binding, lifecycle, limits, auditing and distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: RentRedi provider-contract security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because RentRedi publishes no third-party API or delegated authorization contract for its sensitive landlord, tenant, screening and payment workflows.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable without a provider-approved RentRedi integration contract.
No Hermes tools are callable without a provider-approved RentRedi integration contract.

providerSetup.blocker: RentRedi's public product and help materials document member-account workflows and selected built-in partnerships, but no public third-party API, delegated authorization, granular scopes, immutable account/property claims, credential lifecycle, rate limits, audit identifiers or distribution contract. The member surface contains sensitive tenant, application, screening, lease, bank, payment and communication data, and RentRedi's terms prohibit unauthorized access and reverse engineering.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask RentRedi to approve Relay as a production integration and provide a supported API with delegated authentication, granular scopes, immutable landlord/account/property binding, credential lifecycle, versioned schemas, limits, auditing, data-use requirements and distribution terms. Re-run legal, privacy and security review before implementing any typed tools; keep screening, credit, lease-signing, bank and payment actions blocked unless separately justified and approved.

evidence.supports: RentRedi currently combines listings, applications, screening, leases, documents, rent collection, messaging, maintenance, accounting and reporting for landlords and tenants.
RentRedi describes selected built-in partnerships for payments, listings, screening and organization but does not publish a general developer API or self-service authorization contract.
RentRedi's current help material shows account-based access to payments, tenant screening, communications, maintenance, documents, reports and role/property-based teammate controls.
RentRedi documents encrypted personal and payment information and third-party financial connections, confirming that any connector would handle security-sensitive data.
RentRedi's terms govern paid member accounts, financial transactions and credentials and prohibit unauthorized access, copying and reverse engineering; they do not grant public integration rights.
RentRedi's privacy policy covers personal, rental and financial data processed through the service, requiring strict purpose binding, minimization and retention controls.
